comment: First-party branding graphics of the HTML School Editor for Windows (Markup Ninja), the only binary files this repository allows outside verified vendor files (owner's decision of 2026-11-27, issue #34; rules in RULES.md and AGENTS.md). scripts/check_publication.py admits each file only at its exact path, with this SHA-256, at most max_bytes (never above 1 MiB) and with the content signature of its suffix. The design masters and the asset ZIP stay outside the repository.

html-school-editor-win/ui/assets/ninja-h.use: artwork at the top of the help window
html-school-editor-win/ui/assets/ninja-h.source: MarkupNinja_Assets.zip (SHA-256 2a01cbe0a7b9c729cec969e1631e67b7a06a35f683efad6fb93e57b36312dd66), entry html-school-editor-win/ui/assets/ninja-hero.webp; generated branding artwork approved by the owner on 2026-11-27

html-school-editor-win/src/win/markup-ni.format: ICO with PNG images 16, 20, 24, 32, 40, 48, 64, 128 and 256 px
html-school-editor-win/src/win/markup-ni.use: native icon of the exe and its window (resource APPICON)
html-school-editor-win/src/win/markup-ni.source: MarkupNinja_Assets.zip (SHA-256 2a01cbe0a7b9c729cec969e1631e67b7a06a35f683efad6fb93e57b36312dd66), entry html-school-editor-win/src/win/markup-ninja.ico; small sizes drawn from the original SVG, larger ones from the approved logo
